A report with performanceState Performed becomes one evidence record by the duty's bearer; NonSet and Violated reports carry no evidence. FORCE's Violated state has no deadline behind it, so due2 cannot reproduce it and returns Pending. Read as a world fact — ex:alice compensated — it is one evidence record, and due2's evidence is existential (conformance/README.md), so it witnesses this duty too: 065 permits in both evaluators, for different reasons.
